ruling.recommended_action: Issue a voucher refund of S$2.94 to the rider for the 2.09 km of unexplained off-route driving on the metered RydeTAXI trip (fare.distance_fare 35.17 ÷ 24.94 km = $1.41/km × 2.09 km), and remind the driver of the RD-1 obligation to take the shortest and most direct route absent a reasonable cause; no account flag is warranted (driver route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0).

segment_findings.reason: Departing the pickup the driver followed the quoted route to (1.2819,103.8508), then at 22:46:50 swung east and looped through (1.2818,103.8526)→(1.2807,103.8543)→(1.2795,103.8563)→(1.2781,103.8583) to rejoin at (1.2797,103.8594) — a path outside the quoted corridor costing ≈1.47 km. No rider-named stop or edit-destination (RD-3 fails), no pre-departure agreement in chat (RD-5 fails), no LTA incident and only band-3 ECP traffic (RD-4 fails). Unexempt under RD-1; refundable under RD-2.

At 23:21:20–23:25:50, instead of continuing east on the quoted airport-bound corridor, the trace runs (1.3247,103.9705) west to (1.3289,103.9649) via a u-turn at (1.3288,103.9652) and then back east — a west-then-east loop with no counterpart on the quoted route, costing ≈0.62 km net. No traffic incident (incidents empty), ECP/Airport Boulevard bands are 3 (above RD-4(b) band ≤2), chat shows no agreement. Unexempt under RD-1; refundable under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims 'I followed my GPS; it rerouted me.' System records (quoted polyline + GPS trace) override statements: two off-route loops are visible, and RD-4 requires a mapped traffic incident or documented cause, which is absent (incidents empty, bands 3, fair weather). Neither a GPS suggestion nor the absence of a complaint excuses the RD-1 shortest-route duty.
Rider's '~3 km extra' figure is only approximate; recomputed from the record the unexempt detour is ≈2.09 km, so the refund is computed on 2.09 km, not 3 km.
